'''Chapter 1024''' is titled "So-and-So".

==Cover Page==
The cover is an ordinary page with no cover page format apart from the presence of the title.

==Short Summary==
[[Kaidou]]'s palace is becoming steadily engulfed in flames as the war rages on, and more and more fighters on both sides begin heading to the Live Floor.

Meanwhile, Kaidou attacks [[Yamato]] with killing intent, stating his son is nothing more than an enemy if he truly bears the name of [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]]. Yamato remembers Kaidou imprisoning him in a cave shortly after Oden's death along with several enemy [[samurai]], with the group left to fight over a single serving of food. Despite Yamato's fears that the samurai would hate him, the warriors gave him the food without any hesitation as they treated him with the same warmth as they once did to the real Oden. After ten days, the samurai decided to break free of the cave and confront Kaidou in order to allow Yamato to survive, despite this being suicidal for them. Back in the present day, Yamato expresses confidence in his identity and goal and asks Kaidou why he has taken away both his and Wano's freedom as the two of them engage in a powerful [[Haki/Supreme King Haki|Supreme King Haki]]-imbued clash.

==Long Summary==
On the Second Floor, several [[Beasts Pirates]] watch as their allies collapse, with some deducing the cause was [[Supreme King Haki]]. Sure enough, that is the case, but according to [[Usopp]], who has labelled himself as "Usohachi the Sibling Hunter" while riding a Gifter with a Crocodile for a head, the Haki came from himself as he calls himself the man who defeated two members of the Tobiroppo. The Beasts Pirates react in fear as he tells them to join him, while off in the distance, [[Speed]] says to [[Kurozumi Tama|Tama]] that it is actually [[Charlotte Linlin|Big Mom]]'s Supreme King Haki that is knocking the pirates unconscious, its reach being rather far.

[[Nami]] tries contacting [[Franky]] asking for a status update on [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], but he replies he only knows what [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] said earlier, who Nami says should be with [[Shinobu]] even though she cannot reach her either. Franky says that if there is no update then it means things are fine, and informs her that several pirates are trying to swarm the Live Floor while [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Sanji]] battle [[King]] and [[Queen]], and that they must be stopped. [[Bepo]], [[Shachi]] and [[Penguin]], agree to help. On the third floor, the fire started by [[Black Maria]] goes out of control as [[Brook]] carries a sleeping [[Nico Robin|Robin]] in his arms, and on the fourth floor, [[Jinbe]] is informed of Brook's situation as he wonders who is holding Kaidou up right now.

On top of the Skull Dome, [[Yamato]] attacks Kaidou with '''Narikabura'''. It does not do anything to him as he hits him back with '''Kongo Kabura''' which blows him into a rock. As Yamato gets back up, he reveals that Kaidou has been trying to kill him, with Kaidou responding that if Yamato is going to take on the name of Oden that he should be prepared for war. Yamato asks if it is wrong to admire someone and declares that he loves Oden as he thinks back to his childhood.

In the past, a young Yamato, who at that time was called the "Oni Princess" by the Beasts Pirates, was chained to a gate as he continuously called himself "Oden" and demanded that Kaidou release him. Kaidou asks if he knocked everyone around him unconscious, which Yamato denies saying they just fell over, but Kaidou sees that he has Supreme King Haki too. Kaidou tells Yamato that if he keeps calling herself Oden, he can die, as he has him moved into a cave for a month until he sees reason. Yamato becomes fearful for his life since the cave is filled with powerful samurai, who Kaidou is trying to force to join his crew. He throws in some food and many swords to see if they will fight to the death over it as he leaves. As he does, Yamato begs Kaidou to not leave him in the cave because he believes the samurai will kill him for being his child. Kaidou, however, coldly reminds Yamato of his declaration of being Oden as he seals the cave.
	
Yamato sees the samurai take up their weapons and becomes fearful that they will kill him out of hatred for Kaidou, but to his complete surprise, they give him the food and tell him to eat, which he gratefully does. After Yamato finishes, he asks if he can be a samurai, prompting the one who gave him the food to cut his chains. The samurai tells him that everyone in the cave adored Oden, and they heard his declaration as him. As the samurai requests he be called "Nobody Important," Yamato shows him Oden's journal, and says he has trouble reading it. Everyone proceeds to read it as Yamato is left amazed by Oden's tales. Ten days later, the samurai tell Yamato that at this rate, they may not be able to see the battle that Oden predicted would happen in twenty years. Yamato says he will fight for [[Wano Country|Wano]] on that day, but the samurai decide to break out and fight immediately to make sure Yamato does not die in the cave like Kaidou wants.

In the present, an angry Yamato asks Kaidou why he stole his and Wano's freedom, but he says life does not have simple questions and answers. The two of them both perform '''Raimei Hakke''', releasing a clash of Supreme King Haki that Kaidou is forced to acknowledge.

==Trivia==
[[File:Second Part of Seventh Poll Poster.png|thumb|210px|The second part of seventh poll poster.]]
*When the chapter was originally published in [[Weekly Shonen Jump]], the magazine also featured the the second part of a three-part poster featuring the 50 highest ranking characters worldwide, from the [[Popularity Polls|seventh popularity poll]]. Unlike the preceding and following chapters, this was presented similarly to an ordinary color spread. The official English release on [https://www.viz.com/shonenjump VIZ] and [https://mangaplus.shueisha.co.jp/titles/100020 Manga Plus] did not release it as part of the chapter. All versions of [[Volume 101]] start the chapter with the ordinary page, and the Japanese release features the full poster at the end of the volume.
**In the poster, the ''[[W:c:pokemon:Pokémon (creature)|Pokémon]]'' [[W:c:pokemon:Meltan|Meltan]] can be seen on [[Eustass Kid|Kid]]'s arm, possibly referencing the scene from [[Chapter 980]].
*This chapter was released with the [[Chapter 4 (Shokugeki no Sanji)|fourth chapter]] of [[Shokugeki no Sanji]].
